content.stem: 一位潜在客户走进一家会计事务所，想要成立一家公司。会面结束后，会计感觉很不自在。会计人员的哪两项观察结果需要上报给合规官？（选择两项。）

options.A: 拟成立公司的主要业务为进口和出口新家具。
options.B: 潜在客户对拟议业务的细节描述含混不清，并且对拟议的业务活动知之甚少。
options.C: 潜在客户无法提供有关受益所有人的信息。
options.D: 当潜在客户向会计师提供个人详细信息时，表现出自信的态度。
options.E: 潜在客户能够提供资金来源和财富来源的相关文件。

content.stem_en: A prospective client walks into an accounting firm wanting to incorporate a company. The accountant feels uncomfortable after the meeting. Which two of the accountant's observations warrant escalation to the compliance officer? (Select two.)

options_en.A: The principal activities of the proposed company are importing and exporting new furniture.
options_en.B: The prospective client presents confusing details about the proposed business and has very little knowledge about the proposed business activity.
options_en.C: The prospective client is unable to provide information about the beneficial owners.
options_en.D: The prospective client exhibits confidence when speaking to the accountant when providing personal details.
options_en.E: The prospective client is able to provide source of funds and source of wealth documents.
